answer.why_different: The generated document has a different structure: it omits the request-body description and three media-type entries, including their nested schemas. This is not merely a value or address difference; it removes supported PATCH representations from the request body.
answer.spec_3gpp: The 3GPP evidence specifies four PATCH request media types: merge patch with request-body type Resource, 3GPP merge patch with Resource, JSON Patch with array(PatchItem), and 3GPP JSON Patch with array(PatchItem). It also states that HTTP PATCH is used to create, update, or delete resources.
answer.openapi: OpenAPI 3.0 requires the requestBody content map to describe the available request media types, and each Media Type Object may define the schema for that media type. The requestBody description is a permitted field for explaining the request body.
answer.clearer_why: The official version explains the purpose of the patch body and lists all supported patch formats, while the generated version exposes only one of them and provides no explanatory description.

citations.quote: Four patch media types are available for the request message body.
content | Map[string, Media Type Object] | REQUIRED. The content of the request body.
description | string | A brief description of the request body.

differences.reason: The generated side removes the explanation of the PATCH request body and the list of supported patch formats. This loses API documentation present in the official side; OpenAPI supports a requestBody description (O8), and the specification identifies four available media types (S4).

The generated side omits the 3GPP merge-patch representation and its Resource schema. The specification identifies a 3GPP merge-patch request type as Resource (S21), while OpenAPI requires request content to describe available media types (O1).
The generated side omits the standard JSON Patch media type and its array(PatchItem) schema. The specification explicitly assigns JSON Patch the request body type array(PatchItem) (S21).

The generated side omits the 3GPP JSON Patch media type and its array(PatchItem) schema. The specification lists the corresponding 3GPP JSON Patch request body as array(PatchItem) (S21), and OpenAPI Media Type Objects carry the schema for each media type (O2).
